newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks in London quiet, lack direction.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks in London quiet, lack direction.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks in London showed few signs of life on Wednesday in a market that lacked direction, traders said.
"There was hardly any turnover other than in HSBC", one trader said. "The market seems to be waiting for news to give the market direction."

The Hang Seng London Reference Index was 2.5 points higher at 13,465.11 by 1623 GMT. In Hong Kong overnight, the Hang Seng was boosted by heavyweight property counters, but fell back on selling in banks and conglomerates to close just 8.40 points firmer at 13,462.61.
